title: 第 59 章 你竟然敢抢夺我的功法第 58 章 暖男排狗后面行不行
slug: 我被师姐凌辱你说我罪恶滔天
lines: 陈默穿过外门的几条走廊没过多久就来到了周玄的住处门口，他推开门走进去之后就看到周玄正坐在床上修炼。
当周玄睁开眼睛看到是陈默之后脸上立刻露出了惊喜的表情，他连忙站起身来迎了上去。
“陈默你怎么来了。”周玄说道。
“没事就是来看看你而已，最近修炼得怎么样了。”
“还不错。”周玄说道。
“自从你上次帮我打通经脉又给了我丹药之后，我的修炼速度快了不少。”
“虽然还是比不上你们这些天才，但比我之前已经好太多了。”
只见陈默点了点头然后在椅子上坐下来，周玄给他倒了一杯水两人聊了一会儿。
“对了你听说了吗。”周玄忽然压低声音说道。
“陆云和陆瑶那兄妹俩现在只有练气一层的修为了，听说他们每天躲在屋里不敢出门。”
“以前那些巴结他们的人现在都不搭理他们了，还有人当着他们的面冷嘲热讽。”
“真是活该，他们之前那么嚣张现在遭报应了。”
不过陈默笑了笑却没有接话，他在心里想着那兄妹俩确实够惨的不过也是他们自找的。
这时周玄正想再说几句的时候，陈默的眼前忽然弹出了系统的面板，一条新的任务提示出现在他面前。
【系统发布新任务，请宿主犯下抢夺同门功法的恶行。】
【任务完成之后可获得丰厚奖励，请宿主尽快行动。】
当陈默看着系统面板上的提示眉头微微动了一下，他也是无语这破系统又开始搞抽象了？
不过说起抢夺同门功法的恶行，这个任务倒是有点意思而且也很简单。
当陈默站起身来以后就看着周玄，他的脸上带着一丝笑意。
“走吧跟我去个地方。”陈默说道。
“去哪。”周玄有些疑惑的看着他。
“去找陆瑶。”陈默想了一会然后开口说道。
等周玄听到这话之后愣了一下脸上露出了疑惑的表情，他在心里想着陈默去找陆瑶干什么。
“找她干什么。”周玄问道。
“她之前不是抢了你的灵石吗。”陈默微笑着说道。
“今天咱们以其人之道还治其人之身，也去抢她一样东西。”
当周玄听到这话之后脸色变了一下，他在心里想着陈默这是要替他去出气啊。
“陈默这不太好吧。”周玄说道。
“她现在修为都跌到练气一层了，我们再去抢她的东西是不是有点……”
“有什么不好的。”陈默说道。
“她当初抢你灵石打你的时候可没想过好不好，走。”
这时周玄张了张嘴想说什么，可看到陈默那副坚定的表情之后又选择了沉默，他在心里想着罢了既然陈默都这么说了索性就去去呗。
两人一前一后走出了住处然后朝着陆瑶所在的方向走去，穿过几条走廊之后没过多久就来到了一处偏僻的小院门口。
院子里很安静里面只有陆瑶一个人坐在石凳上修炼，她的脸色难看眉头紧锁似乎在为什么事情烦恼。
自从她的修为跌到练气一层之后已经没什么修炼的意义了，可她还是不甘心想要想办法恢复修为。
可不管她怎么努力体内的真元都不见增长反而还在缓慢流失，陆瑶越想越气恨不得把眼前的石桌砸了。
正在这时她听到院门外传来脚步声，抬起头就看到陈默和周玄两人走了进来。
很快陆瑶的脸色当场就变了，她的眼中闪过一丝恐惧和仇恨。
“你们来干什么。”陆瑶站起身来冷声道。
“这里不欢迎你们，给我滚出去。”
content_en:
Chen Mo walked through several corridors outside the outer door and arrived at the door of Zhou Xuan's residence not long after. When he opened the door and walked in, he saw Zhou Xuan sitting on the bed practicing.
When Zhou Xuan opened his eyes and saw that it was Chen Mo, an expression of surprise immediately appeared on his face. He quickly stood up and greeted him.
"Chen Mo, why are you here?" Zhou Xuan said.
"It's okay. I just came to see you. How are you doing with your practice recently?"
"Not bad." Zhou Xuan said.
"Since you helped me open up my meridians and gave me the elixir last time, my cultivation speed has been much faster."
"Although it's still not as good as geniuses like you, it's much better than before."
Chen Mo nodded and sat down on the chair. Zhou Xuan poured him a glass of water and the two chatted for a while.
"By the way, have you heard about it?" Zhou Xuan suddenly lowered his voice and said.
"Brother and sister Lu Yun and Lu Yao are only at the first level of Qi training. I heard that they hide in the house every day and dare not go out."
"Those who used to fawn over them now ignore them, and some even sneer in front of them."
"They really deserve it. They were so arrogant before and now they are getting retribution."
However, Chen Mo smiled but did not answer. He thought in his heart that the brother and sister were indeed miserable, but they had brought it upon themselves.
At this time, when Zhou Xuan was about to say a few more words, the system panel suddenly popped up in front of Chen Mo, and a new task prompt appeared in front of him.
[The system releases a new task, asking the host to commit the evil act of robbing fellow students. 】
[After completing the mission, you will receive generous rewards. The host is requested to act as soon as possible. 】
When Chen Mo looked at the prompts on the system panel, his brows moved slightly, and he was speechless. Is this broken system starting to be abstract again?
But speaking of the evil deeds of robbing fellow students, this task is somewhat interesting and very simple.
When Chen Mo stood up, he looked at Zhou Xuan with a smile on his face.
"Let's go somewhere with me." Chen Mo said.
"Where to go." Zhou Xuan looked at him with some confusion.
"Go find Lu Yao." Chen Mo thought for a while and then said.
When Zhou Xuan heard this, he was stunned for a moment with a puzzled expression on his face. He was thinking about what Chen Mo was going to find Lu Yao for.
"What are you looking for her for?" Zhou Xuan asked.
"Didn't she steal your spirit stone before?" Chen Mo said with a smile.
"Today we're going to treat her the way she was treated, and we're going to steal something from her."
When Zhou Xuan heard this, his expression changed. He was thinking that Chen Mo was going to vent his anger on his behalf.
"Chen Mo, this is not good," Zhou Xuan said.
"Her cultivation has dropped to the level of Qi training now. Isn't it a little bit..."
"What's wrong?" Chen Mo said.
"When she snatched your spiritual stone and beat you, she didn't think about it. Let's go."
At this time, Zhou Xuan opened his mouth to say something, but after seeing Chen Mo's firm expression, he chose to remain silent. He thought to himself that since Chen Mo said so, he might as well just go.
The two walked out of the residence one after another and walked in the direction of Lu Yao. After passing through several corridors, they arrived at the entrance of a remote courtyard not long after.
The courtyard was very quiet. Lu Yao was the only one sitting on the stone bench practicing. Her face was ugly and her brows were knitted together as if she was worried about something.
Since her cultivation fell to the level of Qi training, there is no point in practicing anymore, but she is still unwilling to find a way to restore her cultivation.
But no matter how hard she tried, the true energy in her body did not increase but was still slowly draining away. The more Lu Yao thought about it, the angrier she became and she wanted to smash the stone table in front of her.
At this moment, she heard footsteps coming from outside the courtyard door. She raised her head and saw Chen Mo and Zhou Xuan walking in.
Lu Yao's expression soon changed on the spot, and a trace of fear and hatred flashed in her eyes.
"What are you doing here?" Lu Yao stood up and said coldly.
"You are not welcome here, get out of here."
